acceptance_criteria.criterion: Episode list renders at most 20 episodes per page
Pagination controls appear in grid footer when episode count > 20
Pagination controls absent when episode count <= 20
Pagination links include ep_page=N alongside page=EpisodeList and comicID
Page loads without errors for comics with 0, 1, 20, and 100+ episodes

summary: Integrated ArrayPagination into EpisodeListPage::_render(). Added use statement for ArrayPagination. Collect all episodes into $allEpisodes, create ArrayPagination with ep_page parameter (20 items/page), attach provider to grid, iterate getSlicedItems(), add ep_page hidden form var. Updated handleRefreshDetails() to preserve ep_page in success/error redirect URLs. PHPStan level 5 reports no errors.

comments.note: No observations — code in the touched files is clean and consistent. The existing _render() was already well-structured; the pagination wiring needed minimal changes. The ep_page parameter naming is clearly intentional to avoid routing conflicts with ?page=.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified. PHPStan (138 files) reports no errors. PHPUnit (60 tests, 120 assertions) all pass with 0 failures. Implementation correctly uses ArrayPagination with ep_page parameter, slices rows via getSlicedItems(), hides pagination controls for <=20 episodes, preserves ep_page in POST redirect URLs, and guards against the page-parameter routing conflict.

comments.note: AC1 (max 20/page): ArrayPagination constructor sets itemsPerPage=20; getSlicedItems() uses array_slice with that limit; the grid loop iterates only sliced items. Verified in code.

AC2+AC3 (controls visible/absent): Bootstrap5Renderer::renderPaginationRow() returns '' when getTotalPages() <= 1. computeTotalPages() returns 0 for empty arrays and 1 for 1-20 items, so no pagination HTML is emitted in those cases.
AC4 (ep_page in URL): ArrayPagination::getPageURL() rewrites $_SERVER[REQUEST_URI] query string, preserving page=EpisodeList and comicID while adding ep_page=N. Verified in source.
AC5 (routing unaffected): Custom pagination parameter ep_page is distinct from the application routing parameter page. No conflict possible.

AC6 (0/1/20/100+ episodes): ArrayPagination clamps current page to [1, max(1, totalPages)], so 0-item and 1-item arrays are safe. getSlicedItems() on an empty array returns []. MergedRow empty-message path handles empty rows in the grid renderer.
Minor: addHiddenVar('ep_page', (string)$pagination->getCurrentPage()) includes a redundant (string) cast since addHiddenVar accepts int directly. Harmless, style only.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified against the implementation. The change is minimal, correct, and architecturally sound. No blocking issues found across all four review dimensions (Maintainability, Best Practices, Security/Performance, Future Context).

comments.note: In handleRefreshDetails(), the ep_page string from $_GET is cast via (int)$epPage with only a !== null guard. A zero or negative string ('0', '-1') will cast to 0 or a negative int and pass through to getURLEpisodeList(). ArrayPagination clamps page numbers on the next request, so this is safe in practice, but a positivity check (is_numeric($epPage) && (int)$epPage > 0) would make the intent explicit. Non-blocking.
Minor: (string)$pagination->getCurrentPage() introduces a redundant cast if addHiddenVar already accepts int. Already caught by QA. Non-blocking, style only.

summary: Documentation updated for WP-001 (episode list pagination). Two manifest documents updated: (1) data-flows.md — added new section '11. Episode List Page' documenting the full render/submit flow including ArrayPagination setup, ep_page parameter, slice loop, pagination visibility rule, and handleRefreshDetails redirect preservation; also updated the Request Routing table to include ?page=EpisodeList&comicID=X; renumbered former section 11 (CLI Batch Tools) to 12. (2) constraints.md — added new 'Pagination' section documenting the ArrayPagination usage pattern, the mandatory custom-parameter-name rule to avoid conflict with the ?page= router, the ep_page naming convention, the 20-items-per-page default, and the automatic suppression of controls for single-page lists. No changes needed to README.md, api-surface.md, or file-tree.md: no new files, classes, or public APIs were introduced.

comments.note: README.md does not mention the episode list page by name, so no user-facing copy needed updating. The pagination enhancement is transparent to the README-level description of features.
api-surface.md already contained getURLEpisodeList(array $params=array()) on Comic — no change required there. The ep_page params array usage is a natural extension of the existing signature.
file-tree.md already lists EpisodeListPage.php in the correct location — no structural change to document.
